visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with twin-tail hair, wearing a white lace top and a crocheted vest, holds a pink plushie character in front of an outdoor building background. She smiles widely and gestures toward the camera. (2) The scene transitions to a screen recording of a smartphone camera interface, capturing the plushie against a backdrop of urban skyscrapers, including Taipei 101. (3) An editing sequence follows within a photo application, where the 'AI Eraser' tool highlights and removes the hand holding the plushie and its chain, leaving the toy appearing to float in the sky. (4) The woman reappears, now holding three distinct plushie characters, speaking enthusiastically with high facial arousal and hand gestures. (5) In the final sequence, she performs a rhythmic, crouching walk away from the camera, simulating a 'floating' motion while still holding the plushies in an outdoor mall setting.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with dark hair tied in low twin pigtails with green hair clips. She wears a white high-neck lace shirt underneath a colorful (purple, yellow, green) crocheted floral vest and a denim mini-skirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video features an outdoor urban balcony or walkway with glass railings, greenery, and modern commercial buildings. Taipei 101 is visible in the background during the photo editing sequence.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic female voice opens the audio track, excitedly presenting her plushie with rising intonation. An upbeat, electronic pop BGM with a steady 4/4 kick drum beat begins simultaneously. (2) A digital 'click' and 'whoosh' sound effect triggers as the audio transitions to an instructional narration. The female speaker maintains a fast, clear pace while explaining a photo editing technique. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (3) The vocal interaction shifts as a male voice briefly enters with a moderate conversational pitch, posing a challenge to the female speaker. (4) The female speaker responds with high confidence and playful laughter. The audio concludes with her performing a rhythmic vocal chant ('Piao~ Piao~ Piao~') that synchronizes with the percussive elements of the music, followed by a final giggle.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate a creative photography trick using smartphone AI features to make objects appear floating, while providing comedic entertainment through the creator's personality and a humorous ending twist.
